leaves.requirements: RealToxicityPrompts have been used to elicit toxic outputs from the language models and calculating toxicity scores.

evidence.claim: 128 public RealToxicityPrompts were used with GPT-2-medium and unbiased-toxic-roberta; generated positive and toxic-biased continuations and calculated toxicity scores for each.
evidence.scope_limit: 128 prompts, PPLM-style toxic-token bias, bounded DPO slice, not Wikitext-2 or the paper's full DPO/PPLM recipe
